title: Lakshya makes another early exit, Srikanth progresses in China Masters
indian_angle: Two top Indian male shuttlers had contrasting fortunes at the China Masters, with Lakshya exiting early and Srikanth advancing.
summary: Indian shuttler Lakshya Sen suffered another early defeat, his third against a Canadian opponent, while Kidambi Srikanth successfully advanced in the China Masters tournament.

title: India to host inaugural Women’s Champions Trophy
indian_angle: India has been selected to host the first-ever Women's Champions Trophy in 2027, with Mumbai and Baroda named as venues.
summary: The inaugural Women's Champions Trophy, originally slated for Sri Lanka, will now be hosted by India in 2027, with Mumbai and Baroda serving as the host cities.

title: Neil Samraj breaks 100m National Record at Youth Athletics Championships
indian_angle: Tamil Nadu's 17-year-old sprinter Neil Samraj set a new 100m National Record at the National Youth Athletics Championships.
summary: Young Tamil Nadu sprinter Neil Samraj broke the 100m National Record twice at the National Youth Athletics Championships, first in the semifinal and then improving his own timing in the final.

title: Mehrajuddin Wadoo appointed India U-17 coach
indian_angle: Former Indian international Mehrajuddin Wadoo has been named the new head coach for the India U-17 football team.
summary: Mehrajuddin Wadoo, a former Indian national team player, has been appointed as the new coach for the India U-17 squad in preparation for the upcoming Asian Cup Qualifiers.

title: Tilak Varma's Duleep Trophy semifinal heroics
indian_angle: Indian T20 vice-captain Tilak Varma delivered a match-winning performance for South Zone in the Duleep Trophy semifinal.
summary: Tilak Varma, captaining South Zone, scored an unbeaten 116 and 51 to lead his team to victory against North Zone and secure a spot in the Duleep Trophy final.

title: Key stakeholders to meet on India’s ODI World Cup roadmap
indian_angle: Key figures in Indian cricket, including coaches and captains, are set to meet to plan India's strategy for the upcoming ODI World Cup.
summary: A crucial meeting involving head coach Gambhir, chief selector Agarkar, captains Gill and Shreyas, and other BCCI officials will take place on September 3 to discuss India's roadmap for the ODI World Cup.
